items.destination_intent: 2026 OITE elbow/sports teaching page, canonical Posterolateral Rotatory Instability section; resolve destination during explicit session logging
items.teaching_point_placement: Beside the distinction between normal LCL/LUCL restraints and the axial compression, valgus, external-rotation mechanism/pivot-shift maneuver
items.caption_intent: Exact user-uploaded figure and caption depicting classic elbow PLRI mechanism: axial compression, valgus bending, and external rotation of the forearm relative to the humerus, including internal rotation of the humerus over the fixed forearm. The radius and ulna rotate together as a unit. Distinguish this combined injury/test load from normal LCL/LUCL resistance to varus and external rotation. Source: Camp and ODriscoll, 2017, Figure 1, https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC5443138/.
